Proposition

1. ch2:2.58↗ lem:polarization-identity The polarization identity (2.2) holds for every scalar product.

Proof

\sketch Bilinearity and symmetry give

\[ \langle v+w,v+w\rangle -\langle v-w,v-w\rangle =4\langle v,w\rangle , \]

without using positive definiteness.

□

For a subspace $S\subseteq V$, write $S^\perp =\{ v\in V:q(v,s)=0\text{ for all }s\in S\} $.
